meta.name: Unicornio: Los guerreros eternos
meta.description: Un equipo de héroes antiguos protege al mundo de un mal supremo. A lo largo de la historia de la humanidad, cada vez que aparece el mal, los héroes vuelven a despertar para hacer su trabajo y derrotarlo.

videos.title: Episodio 1
videos.overview: A young girl, unwittingly infused with magical ability, soon discovers that she is part of a group of eternal heroes destined to fight a supernatural evil throughout time.

videos.title: Episodio 2
videos.overview: Melinda and Copernicus seek the remaining heroes of Unicorn while the supernatural evil unleashes a sinister force to stop them.

videos.title: A Fateful Encounter
videos.overview: Melinda's mental struggle causes her to seek out the normality of Emma's old life, while Edred, Seng and Copernicus are embroiled in a citywide manhunt for Unicorn.

videos.title: What Lies Beneath
videos.overview: An evil foe traps Unicorn aboard an ancient ship where the specter of a vanquished crew will encompass their doom.

videos.title: The Past Within
videos.overview: Emma and Melinda relive moments from the past as Unicorn struggles in the present to contain a creature born out of her magic.

videos.title: The Mystery of Secrets
videos.overview: Melinda and Edred seek a mechanical genius to fix Copernicus while Seng searches for the solution across the Sea of Time.

videos.title: The Heart of Kings
videos.overview: Unicorn's quest to fix Copernicus leads them into a blood war for control over Edred's homeland.

videos.title: Darkness Before the Dawn
videos.overview: Unicorn's search for their evil foe leads them to discover something that will change their lives forever.

videos.title: A Love's Last Light
videos.overview: Unicorn's struggle with the Evil Entity takes them to an unexpected place where their foe's power grows exponentially.

videos.title: The End of the Beginning
videos.overview: Emma attempts to find her way back to Unicorn, while they struggle to hold out against the growing power of the Evil Entity.
